entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Lal Behari Yadav
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

This application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime
No.123 of 2024, under sections 498A, 323, 304 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Chandwak,
District Jaunpur.

2.  At the outset, Sri Sanjay Kumar Yadav, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this application with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court and apply for regular bail.
3. In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 S.S.
